field_text_formatted.value: A value you set while the entity is loading is now kept when the entity arrives (#1036). A field rendered in another component's slot reads its own entity's data (#1020). v-model now works on every module alongside druxt-entity, so exposed Views filters apply (#1037). Changing a filter on page three of a view returns you to page one, as Drupal does (#1032).
